displayName: OCI-PCI-003: PCI-DSS — Unauthorized Access to Cardholder Data
description:
Detects unauthorized access attempts to cardholder data stores violating PCI-DSS Requirement 7

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: pci-dss — unauthorized access to cardholder data

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_003", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%pci%' AND "value" > 0
